routes.name: Visa-Free Entry
routes.summary: Many nationalities enter without a visa for 14 to 90 days. Examples: US, Brazil, Argentina, Chile, Kazakhstan 90 days; Japan, Germany, Canada, Russia, Singapore, UAE, Thailand 30 days; Philippines 21 days; Hong Kong 14 days. Korea gets 90 days for tourism through 2026-12-31.

other: Full list and rules on the official consul.mn page. Lists can change.

routes.name: Temporary 30-Day Tourist Visa Exemption (2026)
routes.summary: Citizens of 34 countries can visit Mongolia for tourism up to 30 days without a visa in 2026. It covers most EU states, Norway, Iceland, Switzerland, Monaco, the UK, Australia and New Zealand.

other: Temporary measure for 2026. Check if it is extended.

routes.name: Short-Term Visa (up to 90 days)
routes.summary: Visa for visits to Mongolia of up to 90 days, for people who are not visa-exempt. Apply through the Mongolian eVisa or consulates.

other: Fees and documents not confirmed. See immigration.gov.mn and evisa.mn.

routes.name: Visa Extension
routes.summary: A temporary visitor can extend once for up to 30 days. Apply online at least 5 working days before the visa expires.

other: Another extension is possible 90 days after the previous one expires.
Not available if you broke the foreign nationals law and were penalized.
